Definition: uncircumcised (i.e. still having the prepuce uncurtailed)
BiblicalUsage: Uncircumcised is the word for one outside the covenant sign, and it becomes the Bible's insult and its warning. The uncircumcised child is cut off from his people, no uncircumcised person may eat the passover, David asks who this uncircumcised Philistine is to defy the armies of the living God, and Jeremiah says God will punish all who are circumcised with the uncircumcised.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the outward sign was never the point, and Jeremiah proves it. A circumcised heart is what God looks for, and an uncircumcised heart in a circumcised body is judged the same as a Philistine's.
